verdict.rationale: Shopify's default checkout flow hands the buyer off to the merchant storefront to pay, and checkouts in requires_escalation must go back to the buyer for input or review. The documented preconditions for complete_checkout include "Buyer has reviewed and confirmed the order", and the call is limited to Token-tier agents granted purchase permission. UCP also specifies AP2 payment mandates: cryptographically signed authorizations tied to cart state, with verifiable boundaries. missing for 10: proof that Shopify itself enforces buyer confirmation on direct complete_checkout (it reads as agent-side guidance), explicit evidence that Shopify's servers implement AP2 signed mandates (as opposed to the UCP spec), and hands-on verification of the checkout/consent step (the runtime probe stopped at cart creation).
